headline: Context Graphs Enable Proactive Enterprise AI Agents
reasoning: This paper presents a novel approach to move enterprise AI agents from reactive to proactive, a significant step for real-world business applications. The 'Context Graph' concept, combined with a Delta Detection Engine and Proactivity Scorer, offers a technically sound and well-evaluated solution, moving beyond theoretical discussions to practical implementation with demonstrable results. The use of established frameworks like RAG and agentic systems, but addressing a core limitation, makes this highly relevant and impactful.
summary: Researchers propose 'Context Graphs' as a live relational data structure to enable proactive enterprise AI agents, moving beyond reactive RAG and agentic frameworks. This system, evaluated across three enterprise case studies, significantly reduces the time to surface relevant information to workers.
